summary: The maintained image helper owns a closed sc2-headless profile through one internal module, sharing command capture, journal and OCI validation rather than a separate launcher. Exact helper/product/source/support/configuration objects and externally selected private product pins are hash-bound before effects; selected correspondence is not operation authority. One original boot/monotonic work interval plus retirement aperture applies across commands, hash scans, sampling and cleanup without phase renewal. Combined raw output and retained metadata are bounded across the operation. Direct-child kernel birth, namespace observation, stream EOF and wait are independent facts: short-child namespace loss is retained as an observation gap, and leader exit does not prove pipe or descendant settlement. Only retained direct birth permits signalling; native censuses do not authorize foreign removal. Shared-host reservations and independent enclosing-cgroup headroom are separately admitted, while sampled affinity/RSS/disk policies do not establish hard containment. Disk population includes allocation context/build/export/evidence and the disjoint load store once. Streaming OCI validation bounds headers, extensions, expanded bytes and virtual path memory, discards tar member caches, and checks regular source evidence before verified same-object load. The SC2-only FIFO exception is exact zero-content CLR debug metadata; it never opens or extracts a FIFO, and aliases, FIFO hardlink targets and nonregular required evidence refuse. Other profiles retain their type policy. Actual-caller synthetic controls cover the shared capture, original lifetime, resource refusals, source substitutions, native dependency gates, OCI replacements and first-cause cleanup. Source controls do not qualify current engines, namespaces, image fit, product behavior, whole-descendant cleanup or worker-loss containment. Native operation remains separately admitted and qualified; restricted product/evidence identities stay outside public source and records. Review found that fsync of journal contents alone did not publish the newly created operation and journal directory entries. The controller now syncs the state-parent entry, empty journal and operation-directory entry before its first launch intent; each intent is synced before Popen. Injected sync failures stop before child launch and retain the consumed directory. Ordered source controls do not establish physical power-loss recovery. Internal profile import suppresses bytecode caching so loading the implementation cannot itself dirty the selected helper checkout before its source checks. A follow-up source-closure check found that disabling bytecode writes alone still allowed a timestamp-valid cached module to execute before cleanliness checks. The maintained loader now compiles bounded regular source bytes directly, bypassing cache reads as well as writes, and binds the captured digest to the externally selected module hash before dispatch. An actual isolated CLI control supplies cache code first proven usable by Python’s ordinary loader and verifies that the maintained path executes source instead; malformed or substituted selection still refuses before launch.
title: Keep the closed SC2 image operation inside the maintained image controller
